cards.text: Jesus and His disciples are getting close to Jerusalem. They come to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives. And right there, Jesus sends two of His disciples out on an errand.

cards.question: Jesus tells the two disciples to go into the village ahead of them. What does He say they'll find tied there as soon as they walk in?
Jesus tells the two disciples what to do once they find the colt: ___ it and bring it here.

cards.text: Oh, and this colt? No one has ever sat on it. ZERO riders, friend. And Jesus even hands them a line to use in case anybody asks what they're doing.

cards.question: If someone asks the two disciples why they're taking the colt, what does Jesus tell them to say?

answers.text: The Lord needs it and will return it shortly
The Teacher will pay you back for it tonight
The priests have sent us here to collect it

cards.text: So off they go, and there it is: the colt, out in the street, tied at a doorway. Me? I once spent a whole morning hunting for my rolling pin, and it was in my mustache the ENTIRE time.

They start untying it, and some people standing there ask, "Why are you untying the colt?" Two guys, a colt that isn't theirs, and an audience… that's the moment your heart drops right into your apron.

cards.question: True or false: When the disciples answer the way Jesus told them to, the people standing there refuse to let them take the colt.
True or false: The disciples lead the colt to Jesus and throw their cloaks over it, and then He sits on it.

cards.text: Jesus is on the colt now, and the crowd goes ALL in. I haven't seen people this fired up since… okay, I spent years in a junk drawer, I hadn't seen people, PERIOD.

cards.question: As Jesus rides along, what do many people in the crowd spread on the road?
Other people in the crowd cut ___ from the fields and spread them on the road.

cards.text: Front of the line, back of the line, EVERYBODY is shouting: "Hosanna!" "Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!"

cards.question: The crowd keeps shouting, and now they call out a blessing on the coming kingdom of their father ___.

cards.text: One more "Hosanna in the highest!" from the crowd. And then Jesus enters Jerusalem.

cards.question: True or false: Once Jesus is inside Jerusalem, He goes into the temple courts.

cards.text: In the temple courts, Jesus looks around at everything. I bet not one thing in there gets past Him.

cards.question: Jesus has looked around the temple courts, and it's already late. What does He do?

answers.text: Goes out to Bethany with the Twelve
Stays the night in the temple courts
Heads back to Jericho with the crowd

findings.problem: The joke's action doesn't match the fact. Mark 11:4 has the disciples finding the colt right where Jesus said it would be, with no search at all. The comparison is about hunting for something all morning that was there the whole time. Searching for a long time is not the same action as finding it just as foretold.

rule.text: The everyday comparison must have the same action.

findings.problem: "I haven't seen people this fired up since…" has Papa Dorin speaking as if he is watching the Mark 11:8 crowd himself. That puts him in the Bible event as an eyewitness.

rule.text: Never part of a Bible event. He never says he was there, saw it or knew anyone in it. His story is only the Millers' kitchen, the junk drawer and the Dorinverse.

findings.problem: The punchline "I spent years in a junk drawer, I hadn't seen people, PERIOD" contradicts his backstory. He lived for years in the Millers' kitchen with the family crowding around for birthdays and holidays. Even in the drawer, people opened it and dug through it. The joke changes established Dorinverse facts.

rule.text: His own world isn't Bible fact. His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them.

findings.problem: This "which thing" question uses "Woven mats" and "Flower petals" as wrong answers. Neither is a real detail from elsewhere in the Bible. They need to be replaced with things the Bible actually mentions.

rule.text: For who, which thing and where questions, wrong answers are real details from somewhere in the Bible, like Joppa when the right answer is Tarshish.
